caption: The drawing depicts a single glass vessel positioned centrally within a rectangular frame that sits on an off-white or cream-colored background. The vessel is transparent and features a bulbous, slightly tapered shape that narrows at the bottom. The glass is decorated with diagonal white stripes that create a swirling pattern around its body. The rim of the glass has a distinct, solid blue color, forming a bold outline at the top edge. There are no additional objects or background elements present within the framed area; the composition focuses solely on the glass vessel. The artist’s signature, “chas. Cateau,” appears in the lower left corner outside the outline of the inner rectangle.
title: Tumbler
